title: Which Animal Survived Exposure to Space?
description:
This animal endured vacuum and radiation outside a spacecraft.

Tardigrades. In experiments, some survived direct exposure to the space vacuum, especially when shielded from intense ultraviolet radiation.

They enter a desiccated tun state that greatly reduces metabolism; survival does not mean they live normally or indefinitely in space.

They were the first animals shown to survive direct exposure to outer space.
